name: 黑棺·终结
description: 目标回合结束时结算黑棺的第二段伤害。
skillCode: var target = context.rulePiece; if (!target || context.playerId !== target.ownerPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var tag = target.statusTags && target.statusTags.find(function(item) { return item.type === 'aizen-black-coffin'; }); if (!tag) { removeRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-end'); removeRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-move'); return { success: false, message: '' }; } var source = battle.pieces.concat(battle.graveyard || []).find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === tag.sourceId; }) || target; var damage = tag.delayedDamage || Math.floor((source.attack || 0) * 1.5); var result = dealDamage(source, target, damage, 'magical', battle, 'aizen-black-coffin-delayed'); removeStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, tag.id); removeRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-end'); removeRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-move'); return { success: true, message: '黑棺终结，对' + target.name + '造成' + (result.damage || 0) + '点魔法伤害' };
